basic_info.description: Welcome to 535 Pennsylvania Avenue, a lovely single family home alternative in Potrero Hill. This modern condominium boasts 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms over two floors with an exclusive use backyard. On the main level of the home is a great room with hardwood floors throughout, a chef's kitchen, and views of the Bay from the bay windows. There are three bedrooms and two bathrooms on the main level including a primary suite with a walk-in closet and en-suite bathroom. On the lower level is the fourth bedroom which could also be utilized as a family room, gym, or a dedicated office. The third bathroom, a spacious laundry room, and access to the backyard complete the lower level. Maintain comfort with central air conditioning and heat, a plus in the sunnier parts of the city. In the shared garage is one car parking and additional storage. The homeowner's association consists of one other owner and allows for short-term rentals offering flexibility and making this home a great investment. Outside the front door is the vibrant Potrero Hill community and a location that provides ease of access to the rest of San Francisco and the Bay Area.
